A named agent's schedules: turns the daemon starts with or without the app open

Usage: cua agent schedule [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add      Add a schedule (give one of --every, --daily, --weekly)
  ls       List schedules [alias: list]
  rm       Delete a schedule
  enable   Turn a schedule on
  disable  Turn a schedule off
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --embedded
          Use an embedded runtime even when a daemon runs

      --daemon <DAEMON>
          Daemon address (socket path or loopback URL)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON=]

      --daemon-token <DAEMON_TOKEN>
          Daemon token (loopback URLs)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON_TOKEN]

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Sandbox state directory (embedded; default ~/.cua/sandboxes)

      --json
          Print JSON

  -h, --help
          Print help
